PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis.en: I'm glad I caught up to you.\nI'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.\pI've been asked to deliver this,\nso here you go.
PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis.fr: Content de te voir. Je suis\nl'ASSISTANT du PROF. CHEN.\pOn m'a demandé de te donner ça,\nalors voilà…

PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerH.en:
There aren't many serious POKéMON
TRAINERS here.\pThey're all like BUG CATCHERS,
you know, just hobbyists.\pBut PYROPIA GYM's KAY isn't like
that, not one bit.
PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerH.fr:
Il y a pas beaucoup de sérieux
DRESSEURS POKéMON ici.\pCe sont tous comme des CHASSEURS
D'INSECTES, tu sais, de simples\lamateurs.\pMais KAY de l'ARÈNE DE PYROPIA
est pas comme ça, pas du tout.

PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChalleng.en: You're a TRAINER, right?\pKAY is looking for new\nchallengers. Follow me!
PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChalleng.fr: T'es DRESSEUR, non ?\pKAY cherche de nouveaux\nchallengers. Suis-moi !

PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieve.en: NOTICE!\pThe PYROPE gem was stolen from the\nMUSEUM by TEAM ONYBRIS.\pPlease call the PYROPIA POLICE if\nyou have any information.
PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieve.fr: AVIS !\pLa gemme PYROPE a été volée au\nMUSÉE par la TEAM ONYBRIS.\pAppelez la POLICE DE PYROPIA si\nvous avez des informations.

PewterCity_Text_Camper.en: I came to see the volcano.\pNow I can't stop looking at the\nlava lake. It's hypnotic.
PewterCity_Text_Camper.fr: Je suis venu voir le volcan.\pMaintenant je peux plus quitter\ndes yeux le lac de lave. C'est\lhypnotique.

PewterCity_Text_CitySign.en: PYROPIA\nCity at the Foot of the Volcano
PewterCity_Text_CitySign.fr: PYROPIA\nLa Ville au Pied du Volcan

PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon.en: CLEFAIRY came from the moon.\nThat's what the rumor is.\pThey appeared after MOON STONES\nfell on MT. MOON.
PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon.fr: MÉLOFÉE vient de la lune.\nC'est la rumeur.\pIls sont apparus après la chute de\nPIERRES LUNE sur le MT. MOON.

PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum.en: Did you check out the MUSEUM?

PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing.en: Psssst!\nDo you know what I'm doing?

PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes.en: Press the B Button to run.\nBut only where there's room to run!
PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes.fr: Appuie sur le bouton B pour courir.\nMais seulement là où il y a de la\lplace !

PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock.en: If you have the right stuff,\ngo take on KAY!
PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock.fr: Si t'as ce qu'il faut, va défier\nKAY !

PewterCity_Text_Grandma.en: Careful near the CAIRN.\nThe flame there has never gone\lout, not once.
PewterCity_Text_Grandma.fr: Attention près du CAIRN. La flamme\nn'y a jamais été éteinte, pas une\lseule fois.

PewterCity_Text_Guide.en: They got into the MUSEUM last\nnight, and no one heard a thing.\pKAY's POKéMON were up on the\nvolcano. Bad timing for us.
PewterCity_Text_Guide.fr: Ils sont entrés dans le MUSÉE hier\nsoir, et personne n'a rien entendu.\pLes POKéMON de KAY étaient sur le\nvolcan. Mauvais timing pour nous.

PewterCity_Text_Kid.en: The stairs are warm! Even in\nwinter!\pI like to sit on them.
PewterCity_Text_Kid.fr: Les marches sont chaudes ! Même en\nhiver !\pJ'aime m'y asseoir.

PewterCity_Text_Miner.en: The crater lake never cools.\pKAY says that's why the FIRE\nPOKéMON here are so strong.
PewterCity_Text_Miner.fr: Le lac du cratère refroidit\njamais.\pKAY dit que c'est pour ça que les\nPOKéMON FEU d'ici sont si forts.

PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab.en: Well, I must be going back to\nthe LAB.\pBye-bye!
PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab.fr: Bon, je dois retourner au LABO.\pAu revoir !

PewterCity_Text_ReallyYouHaveToGo.fr: Non ? Mais il faut y aller, voyons\n!

PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFrom.en: {PLAYER} received the\nRUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.
PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFrom.fr: {PLAYER} a reçu les CHAUSSURES DE\nCOURSE de l'ASSISTANT.

PewterCity_Text_RefAfter.en: CLEO: Take good care of it. The\nnext REFUGE post is waiting.
PewterCity_Text_RefAfter.fr: CLEO : Prends-en bien soin. Le\nprochain poste du REFUGE t'attend.

PewterCity_Text_RefAsk.en: CLEO: A DRATINI came down from the\nmountain, sick and scared. I need\lthree FULL HEALS to cure it.
PewterCity_Text_RefAsk.fr: CLEO : Un MINIDRACO est descendu de\nla montagne, malade et effrayé.\pJ'ai besoin de trois TOUT-SOIN pour\nle guérir.

PewterCity_Text_RefDone.en: CLEO: Thank you again. The REFUGE\nis safer because of you.
PewterCity_Text_RefDone.fr: CLEO : Merci encore. Le REFUGE\nest plus sûr grâce à toi.

PewterCity_Text_RefEarly.en: CLEO: Not yet. Finish the earlier\nposts first. The KEEPER at the\lSAFARI ZONE knows the order.
PewterCity_Text_RefEarly.fr: CLEO : Pas encore. Finis d'abord\nles postes précédents. Le GARDIEN\ldu PARC SAFARI connaît l'ordre.

PewterCity_Text_RefGives.en: CLEO: You saved the day. The post\nhas a gift for you: DRATINI!
PewterCity_Text_RefGives.fr: CLEO : T'as sauvé la mise. Le\nposte a un cadeau pour toi :\pMINIDRACO !

PewterCity_Text_RefIdle.en: CLEO: I watch over the animals here.\nThe world is quieter now.
PewterCity_Text_RefIdle.fr: CLEO : Je veille sur les animaux\nici. Le monde est plus calme\lmaintenant.

PewterCity_Text_RefNo.en: CLEO: I understand. It is a lot to\nask. The offer stands.
PewterCity_Text_RefNo.fr: CLEO : Je comprends. C'est beaucoup\ndemander. L'offre tient toujours.

PewterCity_Text_RefOffer.en: CLEO: You have them! May I take\n3 of them for the post?
PewterCity_Text_RefOffer.fr: CLEO : Tu les as ! Puis-je en\nprendre 3 pour le poste ?

PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMo.en: There's a letter attached…\pDear {PLAYER},\pHere is a pair of RUNNING SHOES\nfor my beloved challenger.\pRemember, I'll always cheer for\nyou! Don't ever give up!\pFrom Mom
PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMo.fr: Une lettre est attachée…\pCher(e) {PLAYER},\pVoici une paire de CHAUSSURES DE\nCOURSE pour mon challenger\lbien-aimé.\pRappelle-toi, je t'encouragerai\ntoujours ! Abandonne jamais !\pDe Maman

PewterCity_Text_Scientist.en: I measure the lava every morning.\pIt's rising. A little. Don't tell\nthe MAYOR.
PewterCity_Text_Scientist.fr: Je mesure la lave chaque matin.\pElle monte. Un peu. Le dis pas\nau MAIRE.

PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildM.en: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild\nPOKéMON out of my garden!
PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildM.fr: Je vaporise du REPOUSSE pour tenir\nles POKéMON sauvages hors de mon\ljardin !

PewterCity_Text_SwitchedShoesWithRunning.fr: {PLAYER} enlève ses chaussures pour\nmettre les CHAUSSURES DE SPORT.

PewterCity_Text_TQ_Ask.en: A STAR PIECE would complete my rock\ncollection.
PewterCity_Text_TQ_Ask.fr: Un MORCEAU D'ÉTOILE compléterait ma\ncollection de roches.

PewterCity_Text_TQ_Done.fr: Il brille au-dessus de mon bureau.

PewterCity_Text_TQ_NoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make room, then\ncome back.
PewterCity_Text_TQ_NoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein ! Fais de la\nplace et reviens me voir.

PewterCity_Text_TQ_Ok.en: Beautiful! A HARD STONE for you.

PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum.en: This is it, the MUSEUM.\pYou have to pay to get in, but it's\nworth it. See you around!
PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum.fr: Voilà, le MUSÉE.\pIl faut payer pour entrer, mais ça\nen vaut la peine. À plus !

PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP.en: TRAINER TIPS\pAll POKéMON that appear in battle,\nhowever briefly, earn EXP Points.
PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP.fr: CONSEILS AUX DRESSEURS\pTous les POKéMON qui apparaissent\nau combat, même brièvement,\lgagnent des Points d'EXP.

PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazin.en: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON\namazing?
PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazin.fr: Ces fossiles du MT. MOON\nn'étaient-ils pas incroyables ?

Text_DreamEaterTeach.en:
Yawn!
I must have dozed off in the sun.\pI had this weird dream about
a DROWZEE eating my dream.\pAnd…
I learned how to eat dreams…\pOogh, this is too spooky!\pLet me teach it to a POKéMON so
I can forget about it!
Text_DreamEaterTeach.fr:
(Bâiiiille) J'ai dû m'endormir au
soleil.\pJ'ai rêvé qu'un SOPORIFIK dévorait
mes rêves…\pEt j'ai appris comment dévorer les
rêves…\pC'est dingue ça !\pLaisse-moi l'apprendre aussi à un
POKéMON.

Text_DreamEaterWhichMon.en: Which POKéMON wants to learn\nDREAM EATER?
